+ # AI SDK 5 Beta Usage Guidelines
+ 
+ ## Introduction
+ 
+ This rule provides guidelines for implementing and migrating to Vercel AI SDK 5 beta in our project. AI SDK 5 introduces a redesigned architecture with LanguageModelV2, new message types (UIMessage and ModelMessage), SSE streaming, and agentic controls. These changes improve type safety, extensibility, and control over AI interactions.
+ 
+ Follow these patterns to ensure consistent AI integration across components and hooks. Reference existing usage in [useBackendChat](mdc:apps/app/src/hooks/useBackendChat.ts) and [ChatSidebar](mdc:apps/app/src/components/chat-sidebar.tsx) when updating.
+ 
+ ## Key Changes from AI SDK 4
+ 
+ - New LanguageModelV2 protocol treating all outputs as content parts
+ - Separate UIMessage (for UI) and ModelMessage (for model input)
+ - Transport-based useChat configuration
+ - Server-Sent Events (SSE) for streaming
+ - Agentic features: prepareStep and stopWhen
+ - Type-safe tool calls and metadata
+ 
+ For detailed migration, see the [official migration guide](https://v5.ai-sdk.dev/docs/migration).
+ 
+ ## Implementation Patterns
+ 
+ ### Basic Chat Setup
+ 
+ Use the new transport system for chat hooks:
+ 
+ ```typescript
+ // ✅ DO: Use DefaultChatTransport for configuration
+ import { useChat } from '@ai-sdk/react';
+ import { DefaultChatTransport } from 'ai';
+ 
+ const { messages, sendMessage } = useChat({
+   transport: new DefaultChatTransport({
+     api: '/api/chat',
+     headers: { 'Custom-Header': 'value' },
+   }),
+ });
+ ```
+ 
+ ```typescript
+ // ❌ DON'T: Use old useChat without transport
+ const { messages } = useChat({ api: '/api/chat' });
+ ```
+ 
+ ### Message Handling
+ 
+ Always convert UIMessages to ModelMessages before sending to models:
+ 
+ ```typescript
+ // ✅ DO: Explicit conversion with metadata
+ import { convertToModelMessages, streamText } from 'ai';
+ 
+ const result = await streamText({
+   model: openai('gpt-4o'),
+   messages: convertToModelMessages(uiMessages),
+ });
+ ```
+ 
+ Add type-safe metadata:
+ 
+ ```typescript
+ // Define schema
+ const metadataSchema = z.object({
+   duration: z.number().optional(),
+   model: z.string().optional(),
+ });
+ 
+ // Add to stream
+ result.toUIMessageStreamResponse({
+   metadata: { duration: 1500, model: 'gpt-4o' } as z.infer<typeof metadataSchema>,
+ });
+ ```
+ 
+ ### Tool Usage
+ 
+ Define tools with input/output schemas for type safety:
+ 
+ ```typescript
+ // ✅ DO: Type-safe tools
+ import { tool } from 'ai';
+ import { z } from 'zod';
+ 
+ const weatherTool = tool({
+   description: 'Get weather information',
+   inputSchema: z.object({ city: z.string() }),
+   outputSchema: z.object({
+     temperature: z.number(),
+     conditions: z.string(),
+   }),
+   execute: async ({ city }) => ({
+     temperature: 72,
+     conditions: 'sunny',
+   }),
+ });
+ ```
+ 
+ ## Migration Steps
+ 
+ 1. Update package: `bun add ai@beta @ai-sdk/openai@beta @ai-sdk/react@beta`
+ 2. Replace useChat with transport configuration
+ 3. Implement UIMessage/ModelMessage conversion
+ 4. Update streaming to SSE
+ 5. Add type-safe tools and metadata where appropriate
+ 
+ Test thoroughly, especially streaming and tool calls.
+ 
+ ## Common Pitfalls
+ 
+ - Forgetting to convert UIMessages to ModelMessages before model calls
+ - Not handling new content part types in UI rendering
+ - Missing 'use client' in components using hooks
+ - Overlooking transport configuration for custom headers
+ 
+ ## Resources
+ 
+ - [AI SDK 5 Beta Announcement](https://v5.ai-sdk.dev/docs/announcing-ai-sdk-5-beta)
+ - [Official Docs](https://v5.ai-sdk.dev/docs)
